title: Xilonimeh | Anime Tracker
description: Xilonimeh is a desktop anime tracker for personal watch lists.
heroText: A personal anime notebook: lightweight, installable, and ready to organize your watch list, statuses, and watched episodes.
featuresTitle: Dark visuals, fast flow, real app energy
featuresText: Xilonimeh is built for daily use: focused, clean, and detailed enough to feel like a polished product.
feature1Text: Add anime, set watch status, and keep track of watched episodes.
feature2Text: Your data stays on your own computer, and the first install starts with a clean empty list.
feature3Text: A polished multilingual page with Persian, English, Russian, Chinese, and Japanese support.
feature4Text: No raw Windows frame: custom controls, custom icon, and a distinct product identity.
downloadText: No direct installer file is hosted in this section. Use GitHub Releases to get the available builds.
aboutTitle: A small start for anime fans
aboutText: Xilonimeh was made to help make anime watching more organized. This release is early, but it sets the base for better, prettier, and more useful versions.
webAppTitle: The same Xilonimeh, now inside a web account
webAppText: After login, the desktop app and web app use one API and one central database for anime lists, watch status, and progress.
blogText: A place for Xilonimeh news, fresh anime picks, watch recommendations, and important changelogs.
accountText: After login, the desktop app and web app connect to the API with a token and save anime lists in the central database.
